description: Where a STRUCTURED type may not go although the plain one may, every cell live-measured with its paired plain-type guard: text casts (every spelling, TRY_CAST and the TO_VARCHAR/TO_CHAR functions) refuse a structured source quoting the call back while plain values still render; TRY_CAST family rules (VARIANT target takes every semi-structured source, plain OBJECT/ARRAY targets take only their own family, a VARIANT source reaches only VARIANT, scalar pairs stay rejected, CAST/:: stay looser, the laundering escape works); ARRAY_AGG/ARRAY_UNIQUE_AGG/OBJECT_AGG refuse structured values in every written form; the VARIANT-reading scalars and their aliases refuse structured; the constructors refuse in every position with the for-keys tail; while KEY positions, non-collecting aggregates, accessors and explicit conversions all keep working, the rule reading the declared type through wrappers, cast-produced values and every structured shape naming itself in full. Converted 1:1 from expressions/StructuredTypeArgumentRejectionTest (now retired).
